question: How bad an injury can the “Divine Protection of One-Third” split up? A scratch, tooth decay, hair loss, or even though it’s crude to say, hemorrhoids or damage to the crotch?
answer: It’s pretty much up to the will of the individual. For example, Hetaro is usually open to any influence from Mimi, while Mimi idly thinks that her damage isn’t going to her brothers, and Tivey prepares damage calculations so that his older brother and sister can keep working perfectly. However, in the case of damage that places a life in serious danger, if the life can be saved by splitting up the damage, the divine protection does that by itself. If one of her little brothers was kicked in the balls hard enough, Mimi would take the damage for a part she doesn’t even have, it seems…...
